text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I did it! Oh Lord, Lady Shiraoki, and my 
wonderful Trainer-sama-!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"With this many plushies, both of us are 
sure to stay lucky foreeeeever!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please carry one too! With both 
of us having it, its effect will be 
doubled—no, squared!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"We're definitely invincible right now! 
After all, our fortune is super-duper 
mega-lucky, luck at its absolute peak!"
